text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened right after finishing lunch
with Espoir City at a family restaurant—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aah, that was delicious.
Heh, this place is pretty damn good.
I'll be sure to remember it.
choice_data_list: Well then, should we get going soon?
Well then, shall we get going soon?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: Is there something catching your eye?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Ah, no, it's nothing at all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“...She's clearly bothered by something.
And at the end of her gaze was—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A poster for the "Lunchtime-Exclusive All-You-Can-Eat Sweets Course."
choice_data_list: Do you wanna have some sweets?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaah!?!?
I don't even care about that kind of stuff!!
It's not like I like sweets or anything!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Their gaze speaks their true feelings.
Now, how should I handle this—
choice_data_list: Overeating isn't good for you, you know...
Overeating isn't good for you, huh...
Actually, I just wanted to eat it myself—
Actually, I just wanted to eat it myself—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Their gaze speaks their true feelings.
Now, how should I handle this—
choice_data_list: Overeating isn't good for you, you know...
Overeating isn't good for you, huh...
Actually, I just wanted to eat it myself—
Actually, I just wanted to eat it myself—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'll never understand people who get all happy cramming their bellies full of sickly sweet junk. Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we didn't order the all-you-can-eat,
but enjoyed dessert à la carte instead.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Huh? R... really?
Heh, what a wimp!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Then... guess it can't be helped.
Man... seriously can't be helped, huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I ain't interested at all, but...
Guess I'll keep ya company anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Espoir City polished off
a massive pile of sweets.
